name: Burning Fever
source:

Join Tyler in the fun of exploring his kinks (he sure ain’t a vanilla twink) or become a “silver” level or higher supporter and suggest your own (sexual) situations for Tyler to experience and deal with.

A light-hearted visual novel, chuck full with hot muscled guys having fun with cute little twinks.

The little guys get so excited being next to these giants, standing on their tippy-toes to kiss their tall bodies, wrapped in their big, strong arms, and looking up at them from far below.
